2017 Q2.gq: Our outlook for the full year of 2017 is unchanged from what we shared with you at year end and last quarter.

2021 Q1.gq: For deposits, we now expect full year average balance growth of 9% to 11%, higher than previous expectations given the stronger-than-anticipated deposit inflows in the first quarter and the overall elevated levels of core deposits, which we expect to persist for several more quarters.

2022 Q2.bq: On the consumer side, we launched an enhanced cash back credit card offering late in the first quarter and results so far have exceeded our expectations.

2022 Q3.gq: This guidance is reduced from a prior level.

2023 Q1.bq: This result was somewhat lower than the guidance we provided in early March, driven by lower capital markets revenues given the disruptions at the end of Q1.

2024 Q1.gq: Expense outlook is unchanged, expecting 4.5% core expense growth for the full year.

2025 Q2.gq: On loans, we are above our prior outlook, and thus we are increasing our growth range to 6% to 8%.
